name: ssm-contacts
description: Systems Manager Incident Manager is an incident management console designed to help users mitigate and recover from incidents affecting their Amazon Web Services-hosted applications.

subcommands.name: accept-page
subcommands.description: Used to acknowledge an engagement to a contact channel during an incident.

subcommands.name: activate-contact-channel
subcommands.description: Activates a contact's contact channel.

subcommands.name: create-contact
subcommands.description: Contacts are either the contacts that Incident Manager engages during an incident or the escalation plans that Incident Manager uses to engage contacts in phases during an incident.

subcommands.name: create-contact-channel
subcommands.description: A contact channel is the method that Incident Manager uses to engage your contact.

subcommands.name: create-rotation
subcommands.description: Creates a rotation in an on-call schedule.

subcommands.name: create-rotation-override
subcommands.description: Creates an override for a rotation in an on-call schedule.

subcommands.name: deactivate-contact-channel
subcommands.description: To no longer receive Incident Manager engagements to a contact channel, you can deactivate the channel.

subcommands.name: delete-contact
subcommands.description: To remove a contact from Incident Manager, you can delete the contact.

subcommands.name: delete-contact-channel
subcommands.description: To stop receiving engagements on a contact channel, you can delete the channel from a contact.

subcommands.name: delete-rotation
subcommands.description: Deletes a rotation from the system.

subcommands.name: delete-rotation-override
subcommands.description: Deletes an existing override for an on-call rotation.

subcommands.name: describe-engagement
subcommands.description: Incident Manager uses engagements to engage contacts and escalation plans during an incident.

subcommands.name: describe-page
subcommands.description: Lists details of the engagement to a contact channel.

subcommands.name: get-contact
subcommands.description: Retrieves information about the specified contact or escalation plan.

subcommands.name: get-contact-channel
subcommands.description: List details about a specific contact channel.

subcommands.name: get-contact-policy
subcommands.description: Retrieves the resource policies attached to the specified contact or escalation plan.

subcommands.name: get-rotation
subcommands.description: Retrieves information about an on-call rotation.

subcommands.name: get-rotation-override
subcommands.description: Retrieves information about an override to an on-call rotation.

subcommands.name: list-contact-channels
subcommands.description: Lists all contact channels for the specified contact.

subcommands.name: list-contacts
subcommands.description: Lists all contacts and escalation plans in Incident Manager.

subcommands.name: list-engagements
subcommands.description: Lists all engagements that have happened in an incident.

subcommands.name: list-page-receipts
subcommands.description: Lists all of the engagements to contact channels that have been acknowledged.

subcommands.name: list-page-resolutions
subcommands.description: Returns the resolution path of an engagement.

subcommands.name: list-pages-by-contact
subcommands.description: Lists the engagements to a contact's contact channels.

subcommands.name: list-pages-by-engagement
subcommands.description: Lists the engagements to contact channels that occurred by engaging a contact.

subcommands.name: list-preview-rotation-shifts
subcommands.description: Returns a list of shifts based on rotation configuration parameters.

subcommands.name: list-rotation-overrides
subcommands.description: Retrieves a list of overrides currently specified for an on-call rotation.

subcommands.name: list-rotation-shifts
subcommands.description: Returns a list of shifts generated by an existing rotation in the system.

subcommands.name: list-rotations
subcommands.description: Retrieves a list of on-call rotations.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: Lists the tags of a contact, escalation plan, rotation, or on-call schedule.

subcommands.name: put-contact-policy
subcommands.description: Adds a resource policy to the specified contact or escalation plan.

subcommands.name: send-activation-code
subcommands.description: Sends an activation code to a contact channel.

subcommands.name: start-engagement
subcommands.description: Starts an engagement to a contact or escalation plan.

subcommands.name: stop-engagement
subcommands.description: Stops an engagement before it finishes the final stage of the escalation plan or engagement plan.

subcommands.name: tag-resource
subcommands.description: Tags a contact or escalation plan.

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: Removes tags from the specified resource.

subcommands.name: update-contact
subcommands.description: Updates the contact or escalation plan specified.

subcommands.name: update-contact-channel
subcommands.description: Updates a contact's contact channel.

subcommands.name: update-rotation
subcommands.description: Updates the information specified for an on-call rotation.
